        prob = max(min(prob, 1.0 - 1e-10), 1e-10)

        var_l0 += prob * (1 - prob) * (log_p - log_q) ** 2

def compute_lz_drasgow(response_vector, params, theta):
    """Drasgow (1985) lz — no variance correction."""
    n = min(len(response_vector), len(params))

    n = min(len(response_vector), len(params))
